jobs.description: Hello! I’m Allie, Head of Support at Ashby . 👋 Knowledge is one of the most important levers we have for delivering a great customer experience. Our knowledge ecosystem shapes how customers learn Ashby, how our Specialists resolve tickets, and how many customers never need to file a ticket at all. We have a tenured, talented Knowledge Management team doing excellent work. What we’re missing is someone to unify its work into a single, strategic practice. That’s why we’re hiring our first Director of Knowledge Management. You’ll lead a team of Knowledge Managers and expand the team into new areas, including Digital Support experience and content localization. You’ll set the vision, standards, and operating model that connect our customer-facing Help Center, internal Knowledge Base, and the self-service and in-app experiences built on them, including our AI Assistant. You’ll coach and develop a team that is growing and taking on new kinds of work, and you’ll be the voice of Knowledge in conversations with Support, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and beyond. About the role Today, our Knowledge Managers divide their work between internal and external content. You’ll help the team decide where to focus next, in what order, and how its structure should evolve to deliver on those priorities. Knowledge Management is its own function at Ashby, separate from the internal and external enablement teams. You’ll build strong partnerships with both, defining clear boundaries and handoffs so content is consistent, never duplicated, and never left without an owner. Your team will also co-own the AI Assistant’s self-service experience with Product, helping customers find the right knowledge when and where they need it. You’ll stay close enough to the content to coach with specifics, while relying on your team for the day-to-day execution of knowledge governance. Our global employees support 65 percent of the Fortune 500, 50 percent of the Global 2000, and large government agencies. Come be part of our journey! What makes Tenable such a great place to work? When you’re part of our #OneTenable team, you can expect to partner with some of the most talented and passionate people in the industry, and have the support and resources you need to do work that truly matters. We deliver results that exceed expectations and we win together! Your Role: You have built a career carrying a number, and now you want to grow big accounts for the long term. This role is for you. Retention and growth in these accounts is now a top priority, so your impact will be visible fast. You will be in front of customers and in the room with senior leaders, working side by side with our Enterprise and Commercial Territory Managers and Solutions Engineers as an equal. This is a sales role with a Customer Success title. Your Opportunity: Your mandate is to keep our largest customers and grow them.
